mainEntity.name: What is the difference between countertop fabrication and installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Countertop fabrication refers to the process of cutting, shaping, and finishing the raw slab of material (e.g., granite or quartz) according to the precise measurements and specifications of your kitchen. Installation is the physical placement and securing of the fabricated countertops in your home, including sealing and integrating sinks or cooktops. We coordinate both stages for projects in Berkeley, East Bay, Oakland, Albany, and El Cerrito.
